final: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_total) AS total FROM customer_totals), shares AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, c.customer_total, CAST(c.customer_total AS REAL) / g.total AS share FROM customer_totals AS c CROSS JOIN grand_total AS g WHERE g.total IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.customer_total), AVG(s.share), AVG((s.share - m.value) / m.value) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.value
